title: Beautiful Dreamer
attribution: Words and music by Stephen C. Foster (1826-1864), published posthumously by Wm. A. Pond & Co., New York, in 1864; public domain. Written in 9/8 with the eighth note as the beat (dotted quarter = 3 beats), so the tempo is in eighths (about 63 dotted quarters per minute). The C# is Foster's chromatic lower neighbour.
